command:
mkdir -p sui-ownership
cd sui-ownership
mkdir -p .tools/bin .local/network move/sources client evidence
curl -fL https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/mainnet-v1.82.3/sui-mainnet-v1.82.3-macos-arm64.tgz -o .tools/sui.tgz
printf '%s  %s\n' 861f8833c5c7008c86aca50e925043baa8e04332dcbd846cc6c31ea0eee16be9 .tools/sui.tgz | shasum -a 256 -c -
tar -xzf .tools/sui.tgz -C .tools/bin ./sui
export PATH="$PWD/.tools/bin:$PATH"
sui --version
output:
.tools/sui.tgz: OK
sui 1.82.3-bf4073918ed3
note: Checksum and version lines from the verified official archive. Download progress is omitted.

command:
export SUI_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/.local/network"
export MOVE_HOME="$PWD/.local/move-cache"
export RUST_LOG=off
sui genesis --working-dir "$SUI_CONFIG_DIR" --with-faucet --committee-size 1 --epoch-duration-ms 86400000
sui start --network.config "$SUI_CONFIG_DIR" --with-faucet --fullnode-rpc-port 9000

export PATH="$PWD/.tools/bin:$PATH"
export SUI_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/.local/network"
export MOVE_HOME="$PWD/.local/move-cache"
export RUST_LOG=off
export SUI_GRPC_ENDPOINT=127.0.0.1:9000
sui client addresses --json > evidence/addresses.json
ALICE=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("evidence/addresses.json"))["addresses"][0][1])')
BOB=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("evidence/addresses.json"))["addresses"][1][1])')
CHAIN_ID=$(sui client chain-identifier --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["base58"])')
printf 'ALICE=%s\nBOB=%s\nCHAIN_ID=%s\n' "$ALICE" "$BOB" "$CHAIN_ID"

name = "sui_ownership"

command:
